Lord, sustain those searching for someone who is lost. Give us generous hearts when they come home.
Lord, remember those still waiting to be hired when the day is nearly over. Give every family enough to live on.
Lord, make room in our busy conversations for the child at our side. Teach us to welcome you there.
Lord, give honesty to those entrusted with another person's money. Teach us to use what we have for good.
Lord, give us the humility to change our minds and do the good we first refused.
Lord, help us welcome the good done by people outside our circle. Protect the little ones in our care.
Lord, open our eyes to the person waiting in need just outside our door.
Lord, teach those entrusted with land and livelihoods to return good fruit and honor the people who labor there.
Lord, bring children close when adults would turn them aside. Give families tenderness in the midst of hurt.
Lord, strengthen the faith of those doing a quiet duty day after day with little thanks.
Lord, welcome the stranger gathered from the roadside. Make us ready to answer your invitation.
Lord, free our hands from the possessions we cling to. Help us share with someone who has little.
Lord, remind us to return and thank the person through whom healing came.
Lord, guide those balancing public duties and conscience. Help them see your image in every person.
Lord, teach those who seek the first place to serve the person given the last.
Lord, hear those who must ask again and again for justice. Give them a steadfast advocate.
Lord, let our love for you take shape in a practical kindness to the neighbor nearest us.
Lord, hear the voice others try to quiet. Help us ask what someone needs and listen to their answer.
Lord, receive the quiet prayer of the one standing at the back. Give us humility before you.
Lord, bless those who carry heavy burdens laid on them by others. Teach leaders to lift a share.
Lord, gather our scattered attention into love for you. Help us give our neighbor that same wholehearted care.
Lord, bring your welcome to those seeking a fresh start. Give them courage to repair the harm they have done.
Lord, help us tend the small light entrusted to us and keep faith through a long wait.
Lord, see the generosity of those who give from very little. Protect anyone whose trust is taken advantage of.
Lord, hold our dead in your living care. Give hope to those who miss their company today.
Lord, give courage to the person afraid to use a gift. Let what you have entrusted to them serve another.
Lord, hold fast to those whose familiar world is falling apart. Let your word give them something firm to stand on.
Lord, give endurance to those facing hostility for their faith and wisdom when they must speak.
Lord, draw our steps toward the sick, the hungry, and the prisoner. Help us recognize you in each one.
Lord, give courage to those who must tell the truth before someone more powerful.
Lord, remember the person who turns to you at the last hour. Let them hear a word of hope.
Lord, come close to every family seeking a home today. Help us make room for you among us.
Lord, bless those tending a newborn today. Give them Mary's quiet heart for the wonders they cannot yet put into words.
Lord, let your light reach the home where hope is wearing thin. Help us bring warmth and welcome there.
Lord, guide those searching far from home. Give them the wise travelers' joy when they find you.
Risen Lord, walk with those who come early to a grave. Let hope take root where they have known only loss.
Risen Lord, meet the friend who still has questions, as you met Thomas. Make our community a place of peace.
Lord, bless those who, like Anna and Simeon, have waited long in hope. Give them joy in the children they welcome.
Lord, share the joy of families welcoming a child. Let every child be known by name and given room to grow.
Lord, strengthen those entrusted with your people's care. Give them Peter's faith when the way ahead is uncertain.
Lord, bless those who set out to help a relative, as Mary went to Elizabeth. Lift up those who have been overlooked.
Lord, draw near to those who can hardly lift their eyes from suffering. Let them know how deeply they are loved.
Lord, remember the peacemakers and the merciful whose names we may never know. Help us learn from their lives.
Lord, receive those we commend to you by name today. Comfort us with the hope of resurrection.
Lord, renew the life of the people who gather in your house. Keep its doors open to the poor.
As spring light touches new leaves, renew our hope.
As spring dusk settles over the fields, grant rest to all who are weary.
As summer dawn opens a long day, guide our work toward the good.
As the long summer light fades, gather the day's labor into gratitude.
As autumn light finds the turning leaves, teach us to welcome change.
As autumn evening cools the earth, shelter all who seek a place to rest.
As winter dawn arrives slowly, give courage to those who wait in darkness.
As winter twilight lengthens, stay near to all who face a long night.
